property_summary: For any input parameters, the reference contract allows initialize(...) to succeed regardless of whether _baseToken is address(0) (i.e. initialization does not reject a zero base token), whereas the mutant rejects (reverts) whenever _baseToken == address(0).

For every input parameters to initialize(...), the reference contract always allows initialization to succeed (does not revert) when called on a fresh instance, including when _baseToken == address(0); the mutant introduces a require that reverts when _baseToken == address(0), so there exist fuzzed inputs (with _baseToken == address(0)) for which the mutant rejects while the reference accepts.
